text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 2

The panel was all men, you are a man, and the man they hired is a man. An all-male panel tells you nothing about bias against you — if anything it removes the usual inference. Raising it would read as grasping, and would weaken the parts of your complaint that have actual force.

What does deserve pressing: your stronger formal credentials (master's, licence, twelve years) against a bachelor's in geography, and the unanswered request for written reasons. Chase that in writing, cite any local policy or access-to-information right, and ask specifically what criteria were weighted and how each shortlisted candidate scored. "Extensive consultation experience" may be legitimate — or a post-hoc justification. The scoring matrix will tell you.
